# rustinion_escalation_policy (Resource)

Manages a Rustinion escalation policy: an ordered notification path an alert rule or log alert rule can target via its own escalation_policy_id. Step 1 notifies immediately once the attached rule starts firing; if unacknowledged after that step's own wait_minutes, the next step notifies, and so on, stopping at the last step. See escalation.rs in the main repo for the full step-advancement/acknowledge state machine. Each step fans out to every channel in its channel_ids list independently — a missing/disabled channel or a failed delivery on one never blocks the others.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID of the group this escalation policy belongs to.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `on_call_schedule_id` (String) An on-call schedule (in the same group) to name in every step's notification — purely for message enrichment, escalation timing never depends on it. Omit for none.
- `step` (Block List) One escalation step, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--step))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned escalation policy ID.

<a id="nestedblock--step"></a>
### Nested Schema for `step`

Required:

- `channel_ids` (List of String) Notification channel(s) this step notifies through — every one of them, independently. At least one required.

Optional:

- `wait_minutes` (Number) How long this step waits, once reached, for an acknowledgement before escalating further. Meaningless on the last step. Defaults to 15.
